$comment: Standards cited in Edgar's work. collect.py turns each into a training note and adds where it is cited (worked out from the corpus at every build). 'match' is a regular expression for the ways it is written; 'area' is the area of work it belongs to. Always use the edition named in the order or project specification.

standards.title: Axial and Centrifugal Compressors and Expander-compressors
standards.scope: Minimum requirements for axial and centrifugal compressors, single-shaft and integrally geared process compressors and expander-compressors in petroleum, chemical and gas service: mechanical design, casings and impellers, rotordynamics (lateral and torsional analysis, unbalance response, stability), bearings, seals, materials, inspection and testing including the mechanical running test.

standards.title: Lubrication, Shaft-sealing and Oil-control Systems and Auxiliaries
standards.scope: Lube oil, seal oil and control oil systems for special-purpose machinery: reservoirs, pumps, coolers, filters, accumulators, run-down tanks, piping and instrumentation, and their testing.

standards.title: Dry Gas Sealing Systems for Axial, Centrifugal, Rotary Screw Compressors and Expanders
standards.scope: Dry gas seals and their support systems: seal types and arrangements, seal gas conditioning (filtration, heating, boosting), separation gas, leakage monitoring and testing.

standards.title: Special-purpose Couplings for Petroleum, Chemical and Gas Industry Services
standards.scope: Couplings that transmit power between special-purpose machines: flexible-element and gear couplings, rating, service factors, balance, guards and inspection.

standards.title: Reciprocating Compressors for Petroleum, Chemical, and Gas Industry Services
standards.scope: Reciprocating compressors and their drivers, frames, cylinders, valves, packing, pulsation and vibration control.

standards.title: Rotary-type Positive-displacement Compressors for Petroleum, Petrochemical, and Natural Gas Industries
standards.scope: Dry and flooded screw compressors and other rotary positive-displacement compressors.

standards.title: Gas Turbines for the Petroleum, Chemical, and Gas Industry Services
standards.scope: Open, simple and regenerative-cycle combustion gas turbines used as mechanical drives or generator drivers.

standards.title: General-purpose Steam Turbines for Petroleum, Chemical, and Gas Industry Services
standards.scope: Steam turbines for general-purpose drives, usually smaller, spared or non-critical service.

standards.title: Petroleum, Petrochemical and Natural Gas Industries — Steam Turbines — Special-purpose Applications
standards.scope: Steam turbines driving critical, usually unspared, equipment such as large compressors.

standards.title: Petroleum, Petrochemical, and Natural Gas Industries — Air-cooled Heat Exchangers
standards.scope: Air-cooled heat exchangers: tube bundles, headers, fans and drives, structures, and their design, fabrication and testing; used for example as lube oil and process gas coolers.

standards.title: Sizing, Selection, and Installation of Pressure-relieving Devices
standards.scope: Part I covers sizing and selection of relief valves and rupture disks for gas, vapour, steam, liquid and two-phase relief; Part II covers their installation, including inlet pressure loss and outlet piping.

standards.title: Flanged Steel Pressure-relief Valves
standards.scope: Standard orifice designations (letters D to T) with their effective areas, inlet and outlet flange sizes and ratings, and centre-to-face dimensions for flanged steel relief valves.

standards.title: Instrumentation and Control Symbols and Identification
standards.scope: How instruments, functions and loops are identified and drawn on P&IDs: tag letters (first letter for the measured variable, succeeding letters for functions), bubbles for location and type, and line symbols for signals.

standards.title: Diagrams for the Chemical and Petrochemical Industry — Part 2: Graphical Symbols
standards.scope: Graphical symbols for equipment, machines, valves and piping on process flow diagrams and P&IDs.

standards.title: Industrial-process Control Valves — Part 2-1: Flow Capacity — Sizing Equations for Fluid Flow under Installed Conditions (also published as ISA-75.01.01)
standards.scope: Sizing equations for control valves in liquid and gas service: flow coefficients Cv and Kv, choked flow, the liquid pressure-recovery factor, the expansion factor and piping geometry factors.

standards.title: Measurement of Fluid Flow by Means of Pressure Differential Devices Inserted in Circular Cross-section Conduits Running Full
standards.scope: Flow measurement with orifice plates (Part 2), nozzles and venturi tubes: geometry, installation lengths, discharge coefficients, expansibility and uncertainty; used for example in compressor performance tests.

standards.title: Performance Test Code on Axial and Centrifugal Compressors
standards.scope: How to test a compressor's head, efficiency, flow and power and convert the results to the specified conditions: Type 1 tests at or near specified conditions, Type 2 tests with a substitute gas and similarity, with limits on how far test and specified conditions may differ.

standards.title: Thermowells
standards.scope: Design of thermowells against flow-induced vibration and stress: vortex-shedding (wake) frequency against the thermowell's natural frequency, in-line and transverse resonance, and the static and dynamic stress checks.

standards.title: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section VIII — Rules for Construction of Pressure Vessels
standards.scope: Design, materials, fabrication, inspection and testing of pressure vessels: Division 1 by rules (wall thickness for internal and external pressure, openings, flanges), Division 2 by alternative rules including design by analysis.

standards.title: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section V — Nondestructive Examination
standards.scope: Methods for nondestructive examination: radiography (RT), ultrasonic (UT), liquid penetrant (PT), magnetic particle (MT), visual and leak testing. Together with positive material identification (PMI) and hydrostatic or pneumatic pressure tests, these are the usual inspections recorded in a manufacturing record book.

standards.title: Process Piping
standards.scope: Piping in refineries, chemical, pharmaceutical and similar plants: design for pressure, allowable stresses, flexibility and the displacement stress range, sustained and occasional loads, materials, fabrication, examination and testing.

standards.title: Power Piping
standards.scope: Piping in power plants, district heating and similar systems, with its own allowable stresses and stress equations.

standards.title: Metallic Industrial Piping — Part 3: Design and Calculation
standards.scope: The European code for designing industrial piping: wall thickness, flexibility analysis and stress limits for sustained, occasional and thermal loads.

standards.title: Unfired Pressure Vessels (Part 3: Design)
standards.scope: The European code for unfired pressure vessels, including design rules and design by analysis.

standards.title: Pipe Flanges and Flanged Fittings, NPS 1/2 through NPS 24
standards.scope: Dimensions, materials and pressure–temperature ratings of flanges in classes 150 to 2500.

standards.title: Welded and Seamless Wrought Steel Pipe
standards.scope: Dimensions of steel pipe: nominal pipe sizes, outside diameters, wall thicknesses and schedules.

standards.title: Petroleum and Natural Gas Industries — Materials for Use in H₂S-containing Environments in Oil and Gas Production
standards.scope: Selecting and qualifying materials that resist sulfide stress cracking and other cracking in sour service: the SSC severity domains from H₂S partial pressure and pH, hardness limits, heat treatment and environmental limits for carbon, low-alloy and corrosion-resistant alloys.

standards.title: Precipitation-hardening and Cold-worked Nickel Alloy Bars, Forgings, and Forging Stock for Moderate or High Temperature Service
standards.scope: Nickel alloy bars and forgings such as alloy 718; when a manufacturer works to its own derivative of such a standard, the deviations and evidence of equivalence have to be stated.

standards.title: Viscosity–Temperature Equations and Charts for Liquid Petroleum or Hydrocarbon Products
standards.scope: The Walther equation that relates oil viscosity to temperature, used to find lube oil viscosity at bearing operating temperatures.

standards.title: Specification for Structural Steel Buildings
standards.scope: Design of steel members and connections in buildings: tension, compression and buckling, flexure, shear, combined forces and connections, in LRFD or ASD.

standards.title: Hot Rolled Steel Channels, I and H Sections — Dimensions and Masses
standards.scope: Section dimensions and section properties of European rolled sections (IPE, HEA, HEB, UPN and similar).

standards.title: Eurocode 3: Design of Steel Structures — Part 1-8: Design of Joints
standards.scope: Bolted and welded joints in steel structures: bolt resistances in shear, bearing and tension, weld resistances and joint classification.

standards.title: Mechanical Properties of Fasteners Made of Carbon Steel and Alloy Steel — Part 1: Bolts, Screws and Studs
standards.scope: Property classes such as 8.8 and 10.9: minimum tensile and proof strength, hardness and test methods.

standards.title: Rotating Electrical Machines — Part 1: Rating and Performance
standards.scope: Ratings, duty types, temperature rise limits and tolerances for electric motors and generators.

standards.title: Codes for the Representation of Currencies
standards.scope: Three-letter currency codes, used where schedules and cost reports carry more than one currency.
